name: Native comparison F1-F4

analysis.statement: inconclusive at these resolutions — the codes differ by 2.12 % on the 80-cell grid, within their estimated discretisation uncertainties (grid convergence index 10.8 % browser, 17.0 % OpenFOAM), but these are far larger than the 2 % the comparison needs; the velocity-field difference between the codes decreases with refinement (8.44 %, 5.01 %, 2.90 %)

convergence.note: reported only, not a gate (added after F2-F4 were evaluated): closed-strip case at 20, 40 and 80 cells across W; observed order, Richardson extrapolation and grid convergence index (Roache, safety factor 1.25) from the three levels

environment: OpenFOAM v1912 (OpenCFD, Ubuntu package 1912.200626) simpleFoam, laminar; same grids as the browser solver; interpolation none.
